Subject: Post-call recap + pilot credits next steps

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap of what we covered and proposed next steps so we all have a shared plan:

What we heard
- Primary use: chat-based question answering + one-off document summarization; occasional re-ranking for search.
- Current pilot burn: ~1.5–2.0M tokens/day (roughly 45–60M tokens/month).
- Production target: scale to ~3–5M tokens/day in Q4 if pilot is successful.
- Budget band discussed: $5k–$12k/mo depending on unit economics and latency SLOs.

Pricing / unit economics
- You mentioned a target of roughly $25–40 per 1M tokens to fit the budget range you have. We discussed model/quantization levers that typically get customers in that range for chat workloads.

Immediate ask from ACME
- Extra runway on credits so the team can complete integration and run the heavier test suite next 2–3 weeks. You asked if we can extend trial credits and monitor burn rate.

Proposed Redwood actions
1) Sales will request a trial-credit extension; pending manager approval we can provision an additional $7,500 in account credits.
2) Vivek (SE) will instrument token-level cost breakdowns and recommend model/quantization settings to reduce unit cost.
3) We'll schedule a 2-week check-in to review burn rate and next-step pricing (can be a short 30-min sync).

Attached: post-call-MAP.xlsx (high-level mutual action plan).

Next steps
- Rafael: quick approval on the credits request if acceptable to you.
- Sarah: confirm the longer test window (2–3 weeks) and whether procurement needs a PO or formal quote.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you more runway so the team can finish the tests.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary, that looks right to me. A couple quick clarifications:

- Confirming our current observed burn is ~1.8M tokens/day last week (we ran a heavy QA pass); that came to ~54M tokens/mo run-rate.
- Our internal product budget for inference during the initial GA would be roughly $6k/month; we can stretch to $10k/mo if unit economics are in the lower end of the range you mentioned.
- Target unit cost we need to hit to be comfortable is roughly $30–$40 per 1M tokens.

Yes please — an extension of credits through the end of the month would really unblock us. If Redwood can make an additional $7,500 available that should get us through the next test cycle. Procurement will follow up if they need a formal quote/PO.

Also loop in Vivek on any model/quantization recommendations.

—Sarah
Sarah Jones
Head of Product, ACME Corp
